product_category.value: Medical simulation training and software: evidence-based simulators for surgical, endovascular, endoscopic and ultrasound procedures (including robotic surgery simulation), plus custom simulation solutions for MedTech companies

product_category.note: The gallery lists 23 simulators across laparoscopy (LAP Mentor, LapSim), robotic surgery (RobotiX Mentor, RobotiX Express), endovascular (ANGIO Mentor), ultrasound (Aeris, BodyWorks Eve, HeartWorks, ScanTrainer and others), endoscopy (GI, BRONCH, HYST, URO Mentor), pelvic exam and arthroscopy.

platforms.note: Learners train on dedicated hardware simulators (stand-alone, portable, and full suites with original instruments, haptics and physical models). None of the pages describe learner use as Web, VR, AR, MR, Mobile or Desktop, so no allowed label applies. MentorLearn Cloud ('provides an intelligent vision on user performance and usage data anywhere, anytime') is a data management platform for course building and reporting, not a learner mode.

tagline.note: Homepage first headline after the menu. The same phrase ends the company description in the footer of every page read ('...customized simulation to improve clinical proficiency and performance.'). No trademarked slogan found. Other candidates: 'On a mission to enhance patient safety and healthcare outcomes with ever-advancing simulation' and 'Validated Customized Medical Simulation Training' (home).

pricing.note: No prices, plans or quote/pricing buttons on the pages read. Menus include 'Simulation Financing Solution', which is not a price or quote under EXTRACTION.md. Some product blurbs use cost words ('cost-effective' for TEE Express, 'Affordable' for BRONCH Express) without figures.
